system.description: A Prototype Vehicle manages to maintain its high precision tuning only if it is regularly given good maintenance. A Prototype Vehicle requires 8 hours of maintenance a month and a DC 20 Mechanics check to keep it running smoothly. If the maintenance isn't kept up, or the Mechanics check for doing so fails, the Prototype Vehicle loses its +2 Ability increases and its random Benefit (but not it's random Drawback), and moves -1 step down the Condition Track.
